sampling: ONE run. At claim, choose wall+monotonic anchor two seconds ahead before any HTTP; preserve its literal UTC in claim. Slot k starts at anchor+4*k for k0..14. A slot more than250ms late is missed and never rescheduled. Each slot issues at most one fixed five-token POST. Slots remain in the final denominator regardless of observation. First transport/resource/JSON/identity failure stops future HTTP and marks all remaining slots unavailable; after exact five-token identity validation, empty asks, invalid numeric/tick/hash/timestamp fields or crossed books are slot-level unavailable states with no derived bound and do not change subsequent sampling. Freshness/coherence failure alone is diagnostic and also continues. A subsequent scheduled slot is not a retry of a failed slot. No retry, fallback, redirects, proxies, pagination, early success stop or size/event substitution.
identity_validation: Exactly five response book objects, each expected NO asset_id exactly once, corresponding condition_id in market, neg_risk exactly true. No additional/missing/duplicate token IDs. Verify chain summary pinned and status metadata_mapping_compatible_conversion_unproven,55 observations,registered count5 and matching ten token IDs. Current quote snapshot need not be same time as earlier chain block; this limitation remains explicit.
book_validation: Strict bounded JSON. price,size,tick_size,min_order_size must be bounded nonnegative plain-decimal strings with at most6 fractional digits and32 total chars; reject signs/exponents/nonfinite. Require0<price<=1,size>0,tick>0<=1,min_order_size>0; price is an integer tick multiple. Both sides required arrays <=5000 levels each; validate levels, normalize order in memory (do not assume wire ordering) and derive best ask=min ask price. Bids are used only to flag crossed book (maxbid>=minask invalid); never to model resale/rescue or profitability. Require nonempty bounded hash string <=128 chars. Empty asks produce unavailable slot. No depth walk, quantities, fill model or parameter selection.
time_validation: timestamp must be10-digit Unix-seconds or13-digit Unix-milliseconds decimal string; record inferred unit and original value. The docs call this snapshot time without specifying a unit, so conversion/freshness remain explicitly interpretive. Record local request start/end UTC and monotonic duration, plus bounded HTTP Date if present. For diagnostics define fresh/coherent only if each timestamp is no later than receipt+250ms, no older than5s at receipt, and cross-book timestamp span<=500ms. These criteria are frozen; neither common response nor freshness proves atomic/executable liquidity.

bound.quote_unit: Conditional nominal pUSD accounting, using official docs assertion that all Polymarket trading uses pUSD; individual book objects have no unit field. No real USD/USDC redemption/equivalence assertion.
bound.formula: For equal netQ>0 of each of five NO tokens, displayed taker cost>=Q*sum(bestAsk_i); reviewed full-NO source gross collateral<=4Q. Define per-unit optimistic margin=4-sum(bestAsk_i), computed exactly with Decimal. Zero trading/conversion fees,gas,latency,capital/setup costs and no dust/rebate credit deliberately favor the candidate. Acquiring extra gross shares to cover fees cannot improve this bound.
bound.decision: For a field-valid recorded set, margin<=0 rejects positive immediate displayed taker margin under the candidate same-unit conversion model at those recorded quotes; margin>0 merely fails to reject. Record freshness/coherence separately and do not call asynchronous/stale sets contemporaneous. Summary preserves all15 slots and separate counts of invalid/missing/fresh/positive/nonpositive. No all-slot rejection unless every scheduled slot is field-valid and fresh/coherent and nonpositive; even then claim only these15 observed sets under the stated model, not an entire continuous interval or universal absence of profit.
bound.remaining_gates: Deployed-source conversion equivalence, actual successful conversion, authoritative fee rounding/units/delay,depth/minimums,fillable five-leg acquisition/settlement/partial-fill liquidation,gas/setup/dust disposition and inclusion are unproved. None is needed for this conditional zero-cost necessary-condition screen; all remain before a profit claim.

retention: Bounded gzip JSONL of original response bodies encoded base64 plus request/receipt metadata; no plaintext raw file. Each attempted or missed slot checkpoints atomically. Excluded economic fields beyond asks are not reported/analyzed; bids only integrity, last_trade_price/history/rewards never used. Compact derived summary/terminal/supervisor; preserve partial trace and all missing slots on every stop. Default dry mode0HTTP,required --run --plan-sha256 exactpins, refuse existing output. Derived book hash and HTTP Date use SHA256 fingerprints; originals remain in raw trace. Interrupted attempts are unknown, never zero.
